2608.28228.title: Generative AI Alignment with Hinduism's Theological Plurality and Sacred Representation
2608.28228.paper_summary: Generative AI systems are increasingly used to answer personal questions and mediate everyday practices, including religion. However, existing discussions around AI alignment and ethics have largely centered secular, Western, and Abrahamic assumptions about religion, offering limited attention to other faith-based traditions. In this paper, we examine how Hindu users engage with generative AI systems in relation to their religious knowledge, belief, and practice. Drawing on 15 semi-structured interviews with Bangladeshi Hindu participants, we analyze how users interpret AI-generated religious representations, scriptural explanations, devotional interactions, and synthetic religious media. We found that AI can be both accessible and ethically troubling. While AI supported scriptural inquiry, devotional visualization, and religious storytelling, our study also identified concerns about theological flattening, cultural misrepresentation, devotional manipulation, and the simulation of sacred presence and authority. We conclude by arguing that religious alignment in generative AI requires interpretive alignment: systems that disclose their limits, preserve plurality, and avoid simulating sacred authority and sycophantic personalization.
2608.28228.paper_summary_zh: 生成式人工智慧系統越來越多地被用來回答個人問題和調解日常實踐，包括宗教。然而，現有的有關人工智慧對齊和倫理的討論主要集中於世俗、西方和亞伯拉罕宗教對宗教的假設，對其他基於信仰的傳統關注有限。在本文中，我們探討了印度教用戶如何在其宗教知識、信仰和實踐方面與生成式人工智慧系統互動。根據對15位孟加拉國印度教參與者的半結構性訪談，我們分析了用戶如何解釋人工智慧生成的宗教表徵、經文解釋、虔誠互動和合成宗教媒體。我們發現，人工智慧既可以是可接觸的，也可能在倫理上令人困擾。雖然人工智慧支持經文探究、虔誠視覺化和宗教故事講述，但我們的研究也識別了有關神學扁平化、文化誤表現、虔誠操控以及神聖存在和權威模擬的擔憂。我們的結論是，生成式人工智慧中的宗教對齊需要詮釋對齊：系統必須披露其局限性，保持多元性，並避免模擬神聖權威和諂媚的個性化。
